subcategory_text: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform risk response prioritization
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-16, RA-02, RA-03, RA-07
ISO/IEC 27001:2022: Clause 6.1.1, Clause 6.1.2, Clause 6.1.3, Annex A.5.7
CRI Profile v2.0: ID.RA-05, ID.RA-05.01, ID.RA-05.02, ID.RA-05.03, ID.RA-05.04
implementation_examples: Develop threat models to better understand risks to the data and identify appropriate risk responses
Prioritize cybersecurity resource allocations and investments based on estimated likelihoods and impacts
assessment_objectives: Determine whether threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform risk response prioritization.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that develop threat models to better understand risks to the data and identify appropriate risk responses.
Determine whether activities are conducted to prioritize cybersecurity resource allocations and investments based on estimated likelihoods and impacts.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
